jobs.title: Food Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Food Program Coordinator

**Organization:** Daly City Partnership (DCP)

**Reports To:** Director of COVE

**Supervises:** \~20 Volunteers; provides secondary supervision and support when the primary supervisor is unavailable

**Salary Range:** Grade 7 ($28/hr \- $31/hr)

**FLSA Status:** Full\-Time \| 40 hrs/week

**About Daly City Peninsula Partnership Collaborative**

Daly City Partnership is a 501(c)(3\) non\-profit organization dedicated to creating transformative change in Northern San Mateo County. We provide comprehensive, multi\-generational services that empower children, families, and older adults to overcome challenges and promote community advancement. Our vision is a thriving community where everyone is empowered to reach their full potential, driven by our core values of Community, Responsibility, Determination, and Compassion. 

**Position Overview**

The Food Distribution Coordinator oversees the daily operations of DCP’s food programs. This includes organizing weekly food distributions, managing volunteers, maintaining inventory, and submitting reports. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, dependable, and enjoys engaging with both the community and volunteers in a fast\-paced environment. Supervised by the Director of COVE. 

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 1–2 years' experience in a leadership role, program coordination or volunteer management
* Valid California driver’s license and a driving record that meets the organization’s insurance requirements
* Must maintain a clean and insurable driving record throughout employment.
* Experience working with diverse populations
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Familiar with Microsoft Office

**Preferred Qualifications (In Addition To Those Above)**

* Bilingual in Spanish, Tagalog, Cantonese, or Mandarin
* Experience in food security or nonprofit programs

**Operational Responsibilities**

* Act as the lead coordinator for the grocery rescue program and Project Dash, managing logistics, scheduling, and partner communication.
* Safely drive the organization's van to execute grocery rescue pickups and perform Project Dash home deliveries (up to twice a week).
* Coordinate daily operations for Project Dash and satellite site distributions.
* Serve as operational support to the main food distribution program as needed.
* Train and supervise volunteers, ensuring compliance with safety and civil rights protocols
* Maintain volunteer records, monitor performance, and foster an inclusive team environment
* Support clients during distribution and connect them to additional resources as needed
* Utilize digital platforms for communication, scheduling, and tracking volunteer engagement

**Ability to:**

* Follow food safety and civil rights regulations
* De\-escalate and resolve client concerns
* Keep confidentiality of client and volunteer information
* Be able to lift up to 50 pounds, occasionally.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Must perform a background check and driving record check

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Paid Holidays, Sick leave
* 403 (b) plan
* Ongoing training, growth \& advancement opportunities

Employment with Daly City Partnership is "at\-will." Either the employee or the organization may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment. 

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter and complete all questions and assessments on Indeed.

***Join a caring and dedicated team of co\-workers and volunteers who take great pride and joy in helping members of our community succeed and thrive!***

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $28\.00 \- $31\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 403(b)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Language:

* Spanish, Tagalog, Cantonese, or Mandarin  (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: OCIP Workers Compensation Program Coordinator, Google Data Centers
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Healthcare, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience handling workers compensation claims.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience with claims management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) platforms, and standard productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets).
* Solid working knowledge of end\-to\-end workers compensation procedures, claims administration, and relevant state and federal labor laws.
* Comprehensive understanding of medical terminology, treatment protocols, and injury evaluation.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Workers Compensation and Owner Controlled Insurance Policy (OCIP) Program Lead oversees the strategic governance, placement, and daily administration of owner\-controlled insurance programs and occupational injury claims. This role drives end\-to\-end risk management by conducting exposure analyses, directing policy audits, and partnering closely with brokers and contractors to optimize coverage structures and ensure seamless program enrollment.


In addition to program strategy, the lead directs full\-lifecycle workers compensation claims management across employees, owners, and contractors. Acting as the primary liaison among injured workers, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and healthcare providers, the role coordinates quality medical care and facilitates prompt, modified\-duty return\-to\-work transitions. Furthermore, the position ensures regulatory compliance and workplace safety by delivering supervisor training, maintaining comprehensive claims databases, and analyzing incident trends to implement proactive, data\-driven injury prevention initiatives.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end insurance placement and strategic risk mitigation across all operations. Manage data processing for policy placement, oversee policy audits, analyze program structures, and direct enrollments with OCIP brokers and contractors.
* Receive and process claims for owners, employees, and contractors, arrange medical care and facilitate return\-to\-work and modified\-duty accommodations.
* Serve as primary contact for injured workers, liaise with carriers, clinics, and legal counsel and maintain detailed incidents and financial records.
* Deliver supervisors claim training, analyze incident trends to prevent recurring injuries, and ensure alignment with workers compensation regulations.
* Evaluate risk exposures, design proactive risk control solutions, and build strategic vendor and insurer relationships.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst (Temporary)
jobs.description:
Simpson Strong\-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.


Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong\-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956\. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.


Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

**YOU**
=======


This temporary 4–6\-month position offers an opportunity to play a critical role in advancing Talent Acquisition operations. As the Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst, you will serve as a strategic operations, analytics, and enablement partner for the Talent Acquisition team. You will translate recruiting data into clear insights, lead or support TA technology implementations, standardize processes and resources, and create scalable tools that improve hiring consistency, speed, quality, and candidate experience. This role partners closely with HR partners, hiring managers, HR operations, communications, and external vendors to turn strategy into practical execution.


This position requires a proactive, detail\-oriented problem solver who can manage complex projects, communicate clearly across audiences, troubleshoot systems and process gaps, and use data to influence continuous improvement across the recruiting lifecycle.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
========================

**Talent Acquisition Analytics, Reporting and Insights (30%)**


Generate, analyze and communicate TA metrics that help leadership, recruiters, HR partners and business stakeholders understand recruiting performance, hiring trends and opportunities for improvement.

* Maintain and improve recurring and ad hoc reporting on requisition volume, time\-to\-fill/time\-to\-offer, offer approvals, source performance, recruiter workload, platform usage, referral and internal applicant activity, quality\-of\-hire inputs and early turnover trends.
* Prepare quarterly TA performance reviews, executive summaries, dashboards, and slide\-ready insights that highlight progress, risks, root causes and recommended actions.
* Maintain and enhance recruiter scorecards, operational tracking tools and KPI frameworks to support accountability, prioritization and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Analyze applicant funnel health, sourcing channel performance and location\-specific challenges to inform proactive sourcing, advertising and candidate flow strategies.

**TA Technology, Systems and Process Optimization (30%)**


Lead and support implementation, adoption and continuous improvement of TA systems and workflows, with a focus on scalable, compliant and user\-friendly recruiting operations.

* Serve as a key TA project partner for recruiting technology initiatives, including Paradox/Ty interview scheduling and referrals, SHL assessment integration, HiredScore implementation, Workday recruiting enhancements and related platform changes.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, system troubleshooting, hypercare support, issue logs, enhancement requests, access questions and cross\-functional follow\-up with HR systems, IT and vendors.
* Partner with TA and business stakeholders to standardize intake forms, job description/job posting content, required vs. preferred skills mapping, stage definitions, candidate communications and disposition templates.
* Evaluate system adoption and process gaps, recommend improvements, and develop scalable solutions that reduce manual work, improve consistency and strengthen candidate and hiring manager experience.

**Program, Project and Change Management (25%)**


Plan, coordinate and execute TA programs and strategic initiatives from concept through rollout, ensuring stakeholders are aligned, resources are ready, and adoption is supported.

* Update and maintain the Talent Acquisition Playbook, Hiring Manager Portal resources, job aids, FAQs, templates, process documentation and operating standards for recruiters, HR partners and hiring managers.
* Develop and deliver training and change\-management materials for new TA processes and tools, including live sessions, My Workbench content, recordings, guides, communication drafts and follow\-up resources.
* Support structured interviewing, hiring events, dedicated interview pool pilots, first\-year turnover improvement work, candidate experience initiatives and quality\-of\-hire measurement efforts.
* Manage project plans, agendas, meeting cadences, action items and stakeholder updates to keep cross\-functional work moving and aligned to TA priorities.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Recruiting Operations Partnership (15%)**


Act as a central coordination point across TA, HR, business leaders and external partners to strengthen recruiting operations, vendor effectiveness and stakeholder experience.

* Partner with recruiters, HRBPs and hiring managers on recruiting process improvements, branch/location hiring challenges, priority requisitions and manager communication needs.
* Manage or support vendor relationships and utilization for platforms and partners such as Paradox, Workday, SHL, HiredScore, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed and related recruiting tools.
* Support recruiter and hiring manager enablement through clear communication, meeting facilitation, resource sharing, troubleshooting and escalation of system or process issues.
* Contribute to employer brand, employee referral, social media spotlight, community outreach and candidate communication initiatives that improve attraction and engagement.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Data Analytics, Communications, Organizational Development or a related field required.3\+years of experience in Human Resources:

jobs.description:
As a San Francisco\-based independent elevator leader, Star Elevator has spent decades earning the trust of premier property managers, owners, and public agencies throughout the Bay Area. To continue our legacy of exceptional service delivery, we are seeking a Senior Account Manager to serve as the critical bridge between our strategic clients and our talented field operations team. This role perfectly balances proactive portfolio growth with dedicated client advocacy—acting as your clients’ primary support champion to swiftly resolve operational issues and ensure unmatched satisfaction.

**What You’ll Do – A Day in the Life:**

* · Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic accounts (property managers, owners, hotels, universities, municipal agencies).
* · Serve as primary client contact and escalation point; build trusted executive relationships.
* · Drive contract renewals, service\-program expansions, and modernization project wins.
* · Develop account plans, forecasts, and pipeline reporting; meet revenue and retention targets.
* · Coordinate with operations, dispatch, and field teams to meet SLAs, safety, and compliance requirements.
* · Lead RFQ/RFP responses and negotiate contract terms/pricing with support from finance/legal.
* · Track account performance, produce regular account reviews, and present recommendations to leadership.

**What We’re Looking For – Skills to Help You Succeed:**

* · 5\+ years account management or major‑account sales experience (elevator service or property management preferred).
* · Proven success managing large commercial/institutional accounts and closing technical projects or service contracts.
* · Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* · Entrepreneurial Drive: A proactive, self\-motivated approach to identify new business opportunities, and treating your portfolio as your own business to drive growth.
* · Organizational Management: Disciplined approach to keeping CRM systems updated and ensuring internal teams stay informed on project status and client needs.
* · Technical aptitude or willingness to learn elevator systems, codes (California conveyance/ADA), and modernization solutions.
* · Experience with CRM tools and MS Office.
* · Demonstrated ability to forecast, meet revenue/retention targets, and manage complex contract negotiations.
* · Valid driver’s license and ability to travel across Bay Area job sites.
* · Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required.

**What We Offer:**

* · Competitive base salary ($100,000\-$150,000\+) performance\-based bonus/commission structure.
* · Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) and profit\-sharing plan.
* · Paid time off, paid holidays, and structured onboarding/training.
* · Company vehicle with fuel card.
* · Career development and advancement opportunities within a locally owned company that promotes from within.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Star Elevator is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life.

* 401(k)

* Vision insurance

* Driver's License (Required)

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure**

  

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.\-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high\-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

  

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI\-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


You will own the technical and commercial vetting that turns a raw deal into a fundable project — the work that separates a defensible capacity commitment from an inflated one. When a partner asks Crux to guarantee an eight\- or nine\-figure sum, you're the one who tests that number against schedule, equipment composition, and real construction cost before it goes to leadership. Reporting into the Chief Program Manager's organization, you will sit at the interface between Data Center Construction, Energy, MEP, and Finance, making sure every project in the active portfolio is executed against the numbers it was approved on — and flagging it immediately when it isn't.

**In this role, you will:**

* Vet the technical and commercial terms of new capacity deals — schedule, equipment cost, equipment composition — before they're recommended to leadership, right\-sizing commitments rather than defaulting to the number a partner asks for.
* Track every live data center project in the portfolio against its approved cost and schedule baseline, and own the process for flagging and escalating variance early.
* Partner with Data Center Construction, Energy, and MEP Systems teams to translate field\-level execution status into Finance\-ready program reporting.
* Own the interface between build\-side execution and the cost and margin model of record — your data is what Finance's models are actually built on.
* Run the change\-control process for scope, schedule, or cost changes on active projects, with sign\-off gates that keep Finance and Development aligned in real time.
* Build and maintain the tools that make deal vetting fast and repeatable — this cannot be a one\-off analysis redone from scratch on every deal.
* Default to AI\-agentic workflows for cost/schedule reconciliation and variance tracking, rather than adding headcount to keep up with portfolio growth.

**SIGNALS OF SUCCESS**

**After 60 days in this role:**

* Deal\-vetting framework (schedule, equipment cost, composition) is documented and applied to at least one live negotiation.
* Portfolio cost/schedule tracking is live for the current active project set.

**After 6 months:**

* Variance escalation process is running with a documented track record of catching at\-risk projects before they slip.
* Finance's cost and margin model of record is being fed directly from your tracking, not reconstructed separately.

**After 1 year:**

* Deal\-vetting and portfolio\-tracking functions run as a repeatable system others can execute against, not a one\-person effort.

**EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH**

**Experiences**

* 8\+ years in data center construction, capital projects, or infrastructure delivery with direct P\&L, cost, or schedule ownership.
* Demonstrated experience vetting or negotiating capacity/commercial terms against real technical and cost data, not top\-down assumptions.
* Comfortable moving fluently across finance, construction, and technology — this is not a single\-lane specialist seat.

**Attributes**

* “$900M is the ask” is a hypothesis until the equipment and schedule say otherwise — you test the number before you defend it.
* You bring bad news first, unprompted, and own the result — hierarchy doesn't intimidate you and you don't intimidate easily either.

**Mindset**

* High tolerance for ambiguity. The portfolio will outgrow whatever process exists today, and you build the next version rather than waiting for one.
* AI\-agentic first. Fluent with AI agents — or committed to becoming so quickly — and you embed them as first principles in how you and your team work, defaulting to agentic workflows before adding headcount or process.

**Nice to have (preferred, not required)**

* Background in data center construction, controllership, or capital\-projects finance specialized in the build environment.
* Experience with direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling, Level 5/IST commissioning, or other GW\-scale data center technical scope.
* Neocloud or hyperscaler experience (CoreWeave, Nebius, Nscale, Lambda, Google, AWS, Meta, Microsoft) in a program or delivery management capacity.
* Formal cost engineering, quantity surveying, or construction finance credential.

**Salary Range Information**


The annual salary range for this position has been estimated based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

**About Crux**

* We offer generous base, bonus and additional incentive based compensation
* Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* Company\-paid life insurance and disability
* Full suite of other optional benefits
* 401(k) Plan with 4% company match (USA employees)

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager, Validation & Vehicle Operations
jobs.description:
About Lucid



At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software\-defined vehicle architecture, our award\-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.



We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in\-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility.

**Sr. SW Quality Vehicle Operation and Validation Project Manager**


**Engineering \| California \| Full\-Time**


**About Lucid**



At Lucid, we are creating an electric future without compromise. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. We build world\-class vehicles by pushing performance, efficiency, and design beyond industry limits, setting new standards with vehicles like Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity.



The people here, engineers, designers, operators, and builders, came from across industries and around the world because they wanted to work on a harder problem. They care deeply about mastering their craft and delivering work they are proud of. We trust you to take ownership, push beyond what is expected, and help write the playbook for what comes next.



By refusing to settle, you help shape the future of electric mobility and prove what is possible when craft and ambition refuse to compromise each other.


**The Role**



We are seeking a Sr. SW Quality Vehicle Operation and Validation Project Manager who will serve as the accountable Lucid owner for the California assessment fleet, daily Quality assessment execution, and validation project coordination.



This role is responsible for ensuring assessment vehicles are ready, scheduled, configured, and available against software release milestones while managing fleet logistics, repair readiness, OTA and build control, validation support, and cross\-functional execution.



The ideal candidate combines strong project management discipline, hands\-on vehicle operations capability, software quality validation experience, and proactive cross\-functional coordination to ensure Quality assessments start on time, findings are supported with the right evidence, and release readiness decisions are grounded in real vehicle execution.



Mission: Lead SW Quality vehicle operations and validation project execution by keeping the California assessment fleet ready, controlled, and effectively utilized so daily Quality assessments can execute on time and support software release readiness.


**What** **You'll** **Own**


**Fleet Ownership \& Vehicle Readiness**



Serve as the accountable Lucid owner for the California assessment fleet, daily Quality assessment execution, and validation project coordination.



Maintain fleet and vehicle readiness by ensuring assessment vehicles are available, scheduled, configured, and utilized against software release milestones.



Coordinate maintenance, repair, and parts replacement activities to keep assessment vehicles ready for planned execution.


**OTA \& Build Management**



Own OTA and build control across the assessment fleet, including update deployment, version tracking, and configuration integrity.



Coordinate deployment of special builds with Digital Engineering for validation, investigation, and root cause support.



Track vehicle status, software and build versions, assessment availability, repair constraints, and execution blockers in a structured manner to support release milestone visibility.


**Quality Assessment \& Validation Support**



Support Quality assessment execution through issue reproduction, log collection, and clear triage input for findings discovered during daily vehicle assessments.



Perform hands\-on vehicle operations and assessment support as needed to confirm readiness, reproduce issues, collect evidence, and unblock execution.


**Fleet Operations \& Logistics Coordination**



Coordinate drivers, fleet logistics, vehicle handoffs, and operational readiness so assessments start on time and daily execution remains continuous.

jobs.title: Finance & Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Latent**


Latent is building the clinical agentic engine for enterprise pharmacy—software that enables leading health systems to serve more patients, grow their pharmacy operations, and capture more value compliantly, without adding headcount. We are a fast\-moving team looking for thoughtful, ambitious people who want to help build both the business and the systems behind it.

**The Opportunity**


Latent is hiring a Finance \& Business Operations Manager to own the systems that keep the company running: our books, our billing, our spend, our insurance, and our payroll and expense operations. You will be the person who makes sure money moves accurately, on time, and with the right controls behind it.


This is a hands\-on ownership role, not an oversight role. You will work in QuickBooks, Brex, and Rippling directly, and you will design the policies and processes around them. You will partner closely with our strategic finance function—they build the model and the forecast; you own the operational reality that feeds it.


On any given day, you might reconcile a month\-end account, issue a batch of customer invoices, chase a receivable, review expense reports, renegotiate a software renewal, or work through an insurance renewal with our broker.

**What You’ll Do**

**Accounting and the books**

* Own day\-to\-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online, including categorization, reconciliations, and chart\-of\-accounts hygiene
* Run or support month\-end close, including accruals, prepaids, and account reconciliations
* Keep financial records accurate, organized, and audit\-ready
* Maintain the chart of accounts, classes, and departments so reporting stays meaningful as we grow
* Coordinate with external accounting, bookkeeping, and tax partners

**Invoicing and accounts receivable**

* Own customer invoicing end to end, including recurring, milestone, and usage\-based billing
* Ensure invoices are accurate, properly coded, and issued on schedule
* Track receivables, follow up on outstanding balances, and manage collections
* Resolve billing questions and discrepancies with customers and internal stakeholders
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success so contract terms flow correctly into billing

**Accounts payable, corporate cards, and spend management**

* Administer Brex: card issuance, spend limits, approval flows, receipt compliance, and reporting
* Review vendor bills for accuracy, proper approval, and correct coding
* Manage payment runs, track payment status, and resolve vendor discrepancies
* Own vendor onboarding, renewals, purchasing workflows, and contract records
* Maintain visibility into software subscriptions and other recurring commitments, and identify savings opportunities
* Evaluate vendors and negotiate commercial terms
* Partner with budget owners to ensure purchases are appropriate, approved, and within budget

**Personnel expense and payroll operations**

* Own employee expense management: policy, submission workflows, review, and reimbursement
* Support payroll processing in Rippling, including off\-cycle runs, and ensure accurate GL mapping into QuickBooks
* Maintain employee records and support onboarding, offboarding, and benefits administration workflows
* Serve as the first point of contact for employee questions on expenses, reimbursements, and payroll
* Partner with People and leadership so compensation changes flow correctly into payroll and the books
* Handle confidential compensation and employee data with consistently sound judgment

**Insurance and business administration**

* Own company business insurance: renewals, broker relationships, coverage reviews, and certificate\-of\-insurance requests
* Ensure coverage keeps pace with headcount, customer contracts, and our risk profile
* Maintain corporate records, state registrations, and business licenses
* Support customer and partner requests for insurance, tax, and compliance documentation

**Building the operations function**

* Identify manual or inefficient processes and replace them with better systems and controls
* Document financial and operational policies, approval thresholds, and operating procedures
* Help select and implement finance and operations tools as the company grows
* Take ownership of new operational priorities as they arise

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in accounting operations, finance operations, business operations, or startup G\&A
* Hands\-on ownership of QuickBooks Online or a comparable general ledger—not just reviewing someone else’s work
* Direct experience running accounts payable, accounts receivable, and expense workflows
* Familiarity with corporate card and spend platforms (Brex, Ramp, or similar) and HR/payroll systems (Rippling, Gusto, Justworks, or similar)
* Excellent attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy
* Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills, with comfort owning recurring deadlines
* Clear, thoughtful communication with colleagues, vendors, and external partners
* A proactive, low\-ego approach and willingness to take ownership
* Comfort operating in a fast\-changing environment with incomplete information

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working at an early\-stage or rapidly growing technology company
* Experience through a full month\-end close, an audit, or a finance systems migration
* Experience managing business insurance renewals or working directly with brokers
* Exposure to multi\-state payroll and payroll compliance
* Experience with procurement or spend\-management systems
* Interest in healthcare, pharmacy operations, or health technology

**What Success Looks Like**


Within your first year, you will have:

* Closed the books accurately on a predictable monthly cadence
* Made invoicing and collections run on schedule, with receivables actively managed
* Given company leaders clear visibility into vendor spend, subscriptions, and card activit

jobs.title: Digital Accessibility Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Please note:** We will consider both Hybrid and Remote candidates for this role.


The Digital Accessibility Program Manager serves as the operational and subject matter backbone to the Office of Digital Accessibility’s service delivery. This role owns the day\-to\-day functioning of the digital accessibility program in managing the service portfolio, conducting accessibility evaluations, ensuring the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of accessibility reviews from team members, engaging directly with campus clients on complex compliance challenges, and tracking program performance. The Digital Accessibility Program Manager reports to the Director for the Office of Digital Accessibility.


The ideal candidate brings both digital accessibility expertise and strong program management skills, serving as a critical bridge between technical staff and Stanford clients by translating findings, balancing competing priorities, and ensuring clients leave every engagement with clear, actionable guidance. They are equally comfortable guiding a campus web team through a remediation roadmap, reviewing an engineer's audit report for accuracy and completeness, and prioritizing and managing competing tasks with concurrent deadlines.


**Core Duties:**

**Program Management:**

* Manage the digital accessibility service intake pipeline by triaging incoming requests, assigning work, tracking progress, and ensuring reviews and consultations are completed on schedule.
* Coordinate with Office of Digital Accessibility staff on workload planning, deadline management, and service delivery priorities.
* Maintain quality standards for digital accessibility deliverables and consult with digital accessibility engineers on complex findings or edge cases requiring additional interpretation. Ensure findings are presented in a manner that is solution\-focused and actionable for both technical and non\-technical clients.
Oversee the interpretation, implementation and compliance with digital accessibility standards and regulations. Recommend actions and/or resolve complex issues with institutional partners that span organizational and university boundaries.  
* 

**Program Evaluation:**

* Evaluate how existing accessibility tools are offered and based on configuration, adoption, and use, if they are meeting program goals or when alternatives should be considered.
* Identify trends in accessibility issues across campus and surface insights that inform strategy and resource planning.
In coordination with the Director, track and maintain key performance indicators and program metrics, including service volume, review turnaround times, client satisfaction, remediation outcomes, and compliance trends.  
* 

**Planning and Analysis:**

* Under supervision of the Director, execute strategic plans for the Office of Digital Accessibility, leveraging subject matter expertise to meet regulatory and technical challenges for digital accessibility.
* Design and evolve the digital accessibility service delivery model, determining how core services (e.g., audit intake, remediation consultation, procurement review, training) are structured and delivered to improve client experiences.
Apply a creative mindset and bring the ability to think outside the box to create innovative service offerings.  
* 

**Client Management:**

* Advise clients on how accessibility requirements should be applied to specific vendor evaluations while balancing the intersection of technical standards, compliance obligations, and institutional constraints.
* Support clients on complex compliance requirements, including situations requiring creative or non\-standard solutions.
* Navigate difficult conversations with stakeholders who are resistant to or overwhelmed by accessibility requirements.
* Translate technical remediation findings into actionable guidance for non\-technical content owners, developers, and procurement staff.

  
**Core Duties** :


* Lead strategic planning and analysis for complex functions or programs with significant business, regulatory and/or technical challenges requiring subject matter expertise. May provide development of program or function from initial concept to implementation.
* Manage the administration and evaluation of programs or functions. Oversee the interpretation, implementation and compliance with policies and regulations. Recommend actions and/or resolve complex issues that often span organizational boundaries.
* Represent the program or function at the university level and/or to external/internal stakeholders and constituencies.
* Develop and manage outreach strategy that includes relationship development, communications, and compliance.
* Oversee or supervise staff in the development and implementation of programs or functions.
May develop and/or oversee budgets; manage finances including monitoring, analyzing, forecasting, and reporting.  
* 

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree and eight years of relevant experience, or combination of education and relevant experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to influence and motivate constituencies which could span multiple organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated excellent planning, organizational and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated ability to make sound business decisions using good business judgment and innovative and creative problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to manage financial, organizational and staff resources.
* Excellent interpersonal and communications skills with the ability to cultivate professional and business partnerships.
* Relevant subject matter expertise.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Launch Manager - Pharmaceuticals
jobs.description:
**Description**


**You’re driven, resourceful, and above all else – remarkably smart.**


In this role, you will support the development and execution of commercial readiness plans for new product launches. Working with our clients, you play an integral role working to support the launch planning and management efforts across a variety of assets, indications and geographies. The Launch Manager will assist established and emerging life science clients by being part of the team that brings a disciplined approach to help our customers commercialize their brands. You will:

* Facilitate regular launch readiness meetings with stakeholders, executive leadership and coordinate stakeholder support for these meetings. Communicate required tasks, updates and timelines.
* Develop a deep understanding of the market problems of various industry segments and user personas. Effectively position and communicate how the product features and the functionality create client\-based solutions.
* Track deliverables, it's risks and discrepancies across the cross\-functional launch team
* Actively support product and application launch activities including product positioning, promotional and pricing strategies, training and working with cross functional teams

**Essential Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, life science or other related field
* Minimum 2yrs experience with launch management or execution of launch (marketing, branding, project management)

**Desired Requirements:**

* PMI, CAPM (Certified Associate in Project Mgt) or PMP (Project Mgt. Professional)
* Experience in meeting facilitation and strong presentation skills


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $122,000 to $134,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, you're a part of the big picture. You will collaborate with colleagues across clinical and commercial disciplines to guide premarket development through post\-market commercial strategy. Every project is a chance to solve a new challenge, learn from your colleagues, and advance your career. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients' lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


Syneos Health has a voluntary COVID\-19 vaccination policy. We strongly encourage all employees to be fully vaccinated. Additionally, certain local governments or Syneos Health customers may have vaccine requirements that apply to some of our employees. These employees are required to submit proof of vaccination to Syneos Health and maintain compliance with these requirements.
  

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager

As a CBRE Project Management Consultant, you will provide consulting services for a landmark multifamily rehabilitation project — one of the largest apartment complexes in the country, currently undergoing a multi\-year capital improvement and unit renovation program. This includes full boiler replacement across the property, building envelope repairs, roof replacement, common area/lobby upgrades, ADA accessibility improvements, fire/life safety upgrades, and a high\-volume unit turn program spanning studios through 3\-bedroom townhomes. You will help achieve the client's strategic business objectives on a project managed on\-site by a dedicated CBRE PM team.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

Manage all areas of project management for this large\-scale multifamily rehab project — planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout — including coordination of the property\-wide boiler replacement program.
  
Work directly with the client and receivership/investor stakeholders to prepare all elements of the project: scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates \& budget, work plan schedule \& milestones, quality control, and risk identification. Expect 3\-5 client/investor meetings per week.
  
Own project accounting and financial management — maintaining financial controls, cost tracking, and accurate project record\-keeping across a high\-volume, multi\-workstream program.
  
Build and maintain a master construction schedule visible to all trades, ensuring every trade partner can see where the project stands at any given time.
  
Define project delivery resources from pre\-qualified lists or through the project qualification process. Conduct RFPs, complete bid evaluations, and recommend resources to the client.
  
Implement project documentation governance aligned with company and client requirements, using Procore for project management and documentation tracking.
  
Direct the on\-site project delivery team, providing guidance and mentorship — this role includes developing and coaching team members as part of day\-to\-day leadership.
  
Create action plans to meet objectives, budget, and schedule for both the capital improvement scope and the ongoing unit turn program. Track progress and report status and variances.
  
Identify project threats and develop risk mitigation and contingency plans; implement action plans to reduce or eliminate project risks.
  
Apply in\-depth knowledge of multifamily rehab and capital improvement principles to accomplish complex assignments and provide innovative solutions.
  
Coach others and share in\-depth knowledge of project management discipline and related functions.
  
Lead by example and model behaviors consistent with CBRE RISE values. Build consensus and work collaboratively with client and trade partners.
  
Work within broad guidelines and policies; explain difficult or sensitive information clearly to stakeholders. What You’ll Need:
  
Bachelor's Degree preferred with 5\-8 years of relevant experience; in lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and/or CCM designation(s) preferred.
  
Multifamily rehabilitation experience strongly preferred, ideally spanning both high\-rise and townhome product types.
  
Experience with capital improvement projects; boiler system replacement experience a significant plus.
  
Project accounting / financial management background — demonstrated ability to maintain cost controls and financial record\-keeping on active construction projects.
  
Experience building and managing master construction schedules across multiple trades.
  
Strong client\-facing skills, with experience presenting to and managing relationships with clients, ownership groups, or investor/receivership stakeholders.
  
Procore experience preferred.
  
Experience mentoring or developing project management staff.
  
Current Project Managers ready to step up into a Senior PM role are encouraged to apply.
  
Ability to exercise judgment based on analysis of multiple sources of information; willingness to take a new perspective on existing solutions.
  
In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).
  
Organizational skills with an advanced inquisitive mindset.

jobs.title: Document Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:** 

The Document Quality Manager is responsible for overseeing the quality control and quality assurance of as\-built documentation and closeout deliverables for construction of utility infrastructure projects. This role ensures all documentation accurately reflects final project conditions, meets contractual requirements, and complies with company and client processes and standards. The manager leads a team of Document Quality specialists and coordinates closely with project management, clients, and field teams to ensure timely and accurate project closeout, including electronic filing and records management within company systems.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 

**As\-Built Documentation Review**

* Lead the comprehensive review of as\-built drawings, redlines, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy and alignment with final installed conditions.
* Verify completeness and consistency across engineering drawings, specifications, and field documentation.
* Ensure updates from field changes, RFIs, change orders, and design revisions are properly incorporated into final as\-built records.
* Identify discrepancies or missing information and coordinate with engineering, field teams, or subcontractors to resolve issues.
* Promote and foster continuous process improvement to meet or exceed internal and external quality targets

**Closeout Documentation \& Data Analysis**

* Manage the collection, review, and validation of project data shared by the client.
* Analyze close\-out\-phase documentation to identify gaps, trends, and compliance issues prior to final project handover.
* Ensure all documentation meets contractual requirements, regulatory standards, and internal quality procedures.
* Prepare final closeout documentation packages for client submission.
* Act as liaison between client and field team. Able to communicate with field workers as well as upper\-level managers

**Governance, Quality Assurance \& Process Management**

* Develop and maintain documentation review procedures, checklists, and quality standards for as\-built and closeout documentation.
* Implement quality control workflows to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Conduct internal quality audits of documentation prior to client delivery.
* Track documentation status, completeness metrics, and closeout readiness.
* Oversee electronic documentation management in compliance with retention policies.
* Facilitate and ensure alignment between internal vs external quality control standards in a dynamic working environment.

**Team Leadership**

* Oversee hiring, onboarding and retention of Document Quality Specialists; set team goals, development goals, performance management and conduct performance reviews.
* Supervise, mentor, and coordinate the work of a team of four document control specialists.
* Assign review tasks, monitor progress, and ensure deadlines for project closeout milestones are met.
* Provide training on documentation standards, systems, and quality procedures.
* Foster a collaborative and detail\-oriented team environment.
* Collaborate closely with internal field leadership to resolve documentation issues, report outcomes, identify solutions and drive increased collaboration across groups.

**Coordination \& Communication**

* Collaborate with project managers, project coordinators, construction teams, and subcontractors to obtain required documentation.
* Serve as functional owner for electronic document filing systems; folder structure configuration, workflows, and retention schedules to ensure documents remain organized, searchable and compliant throughout project life cycle.
* Provide status updates and reporting to project leadership regarding documentation readiness and risks.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Excellent attention to detail and document quality standards.
* Strong leadership, coaching and workload prioritization abilities.
* Proficiency with document management systems and project documentation tools.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Effective communication and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills when resolving documentation discrepancies.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of experience in document control, project closeout, or quality assurance within construction, engineering, or infrastructure projects.
* Experience reviewing as\-built drawings and closeout documentation packages.
* Demonstrated experience supervising or leading a documentation team.
* Strong analytical skills for reviewing large documentation sets and identifying discrepancies.

Desired:

* Experience with construction closeout processes for large\-scale infrastructure or capital projects.
* Familiarity with utility industry documentation standards and regulatory requirements.
* Experience with digital document control systems (e.g., Monday.com, SharePoint, or similar platforms).

Pay: $105,000\.00 \- $158,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

* Can you verify the completeness and consistency across engineering drawings, specifications, and field documentation?

* How many years of experience do you have supporting Utility Construction?
* Do you have experience supporting any type of construction in the past please explain?
* Do you have experience with construction closeout processes for large\-scale infrastructure or capital projects?
* Do you have exposure with digital document control systems (e.g., Monday.com, SharePoint, or similar platforms).?

jobs.title: Quality Assurance/Quality Control Specialist
jobs.description:
Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) Specialist

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Semiconductor Equipment Manufacturing / Precision Manufacturing  
**Department:** Quality  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and hands\-on **Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) Specialist** to join our semiconductor equipment manufacturing team.

The QA/QC Specialist will be responsible for inspecting incoming, in\-process, and finished components to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, customer specifications, and internal quality standards. This position will also support quality documentation, non\-conformance management, corrective actions, supplier quality, and continuous improvement activities.

The ideal candidate has experience in **precision machining, semiconductor equipment, or high\-precision manufacturing** and is comfortable working with engineering drawings, inspection equipment, and quality documentation.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform **incoming, in\-process, and final inspections** of precision machined parts, fabricated components, assemblies, and purchased materials.
* Inspect parts according to **engineering drawings, specifications, tolerances, and customer requirements**.
* Use inspection and measurement equipment such as **calipers, micrometers, height gauges, pin gauges, thread gauges, surface roughness testers, optical measurement systems, and CMM equipment**, as applicable.
* Review and interpret **engineering drawings, GD\&T, dimensions, tolerances, surface finish requirements, and inspection criteria**.
* Verify material certifications, inspection reports, Certificates of Conformance (CoC), and other supplier quality documentation.
* Document inspection results accurately and maintain complete, traceable quality records.
* Identify, document, and control **non\-conforming materials and products**.
* Generate and manage **Non\-Conformance Reports (NCRs)** and coordinate disposition with Engineering, Manufacturing, Purchasing, and other departments.
* Assist with **root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA)** for internal, supplier, and customer quality issues.
* Support supplier quality activities, including communicating quality issues, reviewing corrective actions, and monitoring supplier performance.
* Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve dimensional, workmanship, documentation, and manufacturing quality issues.
* Support customer quality requirements and assist with customer complaints, returns, and corrective action requests when necessary.
* Ensure inspection tools and measurement equipment are properly maintained and within calibration.
* Assist with maintaining and improving quality procedures, inspection instructions, forms, and work instructions.
* Support internal and external quality audits as required.
* Participate in continuous improvement efforts to reduce defects, rework, scrap, and recurring quality issues.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and controlled inspection/work area.
* Perform other quality\-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related technical field is preferred.
* **2\+ years of QA/QC or inspection experience** in semiconductor equipment, precision machining, aerospace, medical device, or another high\-precision manufacturing environment preferred.
* Experience inspecting **CNC machined components and precision mechanical parts** is highly preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret **mechanical drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and GD\&T**.
* Hands\-on experience using precision measurement and inspection tools.
* Understanding of **quality inspection processes, NCRs, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and document control**.
* Familiarity with **ISO 9001 or similar Quality Management Systems (QMS)** is preferred.
* Experience with CMM inspection is a plus.
* Knowledge of semiconductor equipment manufacturing requirements, cleanliness standards, surface finish requirements, and precision components is a plus.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and general computer systems.
* Strong attention to detail with excellent documentation and organizational skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate quality concerns professionally with suppliers, customers, engineers, and production personnel.
* Ability to prioritize multiple inspections and quality issues in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Engineering, Production, Purchasing, and Management.

Preferred Skills

* Semiconductor equipment or semiconductor industry experience
* CNC machining / precision machining knowledge
* GD\&T
* CMM inspection
* First Article Inspection (FAI)
* Incoming Quality Control (IQC)
* In\-Process Quality Control (IPQC)
* Final Quality Control (FQC)
* Supplier Quality
* NCR / MRB management
* Root Cause Analysis
* CAPA / Corrective Action
* 5 Why / Fishbone analysis
* ISO 9001
* Calibration management
* Inspection report preparation
* Blueprint / engineering drawing interpretation

Physical Requirements

* Ability to stand and work in an inspection/manufacturing environment for extended periods.
* Ability to safely handle and inspect mechanical components of various sizes.
* Ability to lift up to **30 lbs.** as needed.
* Ability to visually inspect precision components and use measurement equipment accurately.

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation based on experience
* Health, dental, and vision benefits
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement
* Hands\-on experience in the semiconductor equipment manufacturing industry
* Collaborative environment working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams

jobs.title: Specialist, Quality Assurance, Fremont CA ONSITE
jobs.description:
As an employee of Boehringer Ingelheim, you will actively contribute to the discovery, development and delivery of our products to our patients and customers. Our global presence provides opportunity for all employees to collaborate internationally, offering visibility and opportunity to directly contribute to the companies' success. We realize that our strength and competitive advantage lie with our people. We support our employees in a number of ways to foster a healthy working environment, meaningful work, mobility, networking and work\-life balance. Our competitive compensation and benefit programs reflect Boehringer Ingelheim's high regard for our employees.  



The Specialist, Quality Assurance executes assigned quality activities to ensure full compliance with product requirements, cGMP regulations, applicable regulatory standards, internal quality policies, and established customer commitments. In this role, the Specialist applies sound judgment and attention to detail to maintain product integrity and ensure that operations remain aligned with the organization’s quality systems and expectations.  



The Specialist also leads, supports, and contributes to minor, well‑defined cross‑functional continuous improvement initiatives. These efforts help strengthen product quality, enhance operational consistency, and maintain a high level of regulatory readiness. Through effective collaboration with peers and partner functions, the Specialist plays an active role in improving processes, resolving simple issues, and supporting the delivery of high‑quality products.  



This position offers a base salary typically between ($60,000\) and ($97,000\). There is opportunity to consider higher compensation above this range based on business need, candidate experience and or skills. The position may be eligible for a role specific variable or performance based bonus and or other compensation elements.


**Duties \& Responsibilities**
------------------------------

* Execute assigned quality activities to ensure compliance with product requirements, cGMP regulations, regulatory standards, internal quality policies, and customer commitments.
* Apply sound judgment and attention to detail to maintain product integrity and ensure alignment with the organization’s quality systems.
* Lead, support, and contribute to minor, well‑defined cross‑functional continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen product quality and regulatory readiness.
* Collaborate effectively with peers and partner functions to improve processes, resolve simple issues, and support high‑quality product delivery.
* Support subject matter experts (SMEs) and management system owners (MSOs) in completing straightforward tasks, such as SOP updates required by CAPA activities.
* Perform data collection, assessment, evaluation, and periodic trending and reporting as defined in area SOPs.
* Contribute to preparation of annual and periodic quality reviews, failure trending, and KPI data as assigned.
* Support implementation of the Batch Disposition quality system by contributing to documentation readiness, data collection, and discrepancy resolution to enable timely disposition.
* Allow, endorse, or approve predefined activities (e.g., change records), assessments (e.g., trending reports), documents (e.g., protocols), and minor procedural updates (e.g., SOP revisions) in alignment with Boehringer Ingelheim governance.
* Perform approvals, as assigned, of master batch records, executed batch records, change control records, investigations, discrepancy risk assessments, complaint investigations, annual product reviews, supplier qualification records, and extension requests.
* Maintain shopfloor presence during GMP operations to provide in‑person oversight and auditing, ensuring adherence to SOPs, data integrity expectations, cleanroom behaviors, and identification of operational risks.
* Perform sampling and inspection activities—such as visual inspection checks—in accordance with applicable area SOPs.
* Exercise authority to suspend GxP operations when warranted, providing guidance on required remediation actions and escalating critical issues as needed.
* Engage professionally with manufacturing staff during area tours, clearly communicating observations and escalating trends to management when necessary.
* Perform additional quality‑related duties as assigned, including preparing documentation for regulatory submissions, contributing to site readiness for audits and inspections, and supporting compliance teams during such audits.
* Represent BI Fremont during audits and inspections, supporting and defending site practices, positions, and decisions when challenged.
**Requirements**
----------------

* Requires a bachelor’s degree, preferably in a scientific discipline, with a minimum of 3 years of experience in Quality\-related aspects of the life sciences or a closely related industry.
In lieu of a bachelor’s degree, a High School Diploma plus 7 years of experience in Quality\-related roles within the life sciences or a closely related industry is acceptable.  
* 

**Communications**

* **Written:** Authors clear impact assessments and investigation narratives supported by traceable evidence.
* **Verbal:** Provides audience‑aware status updates; frames risk, impact, and required decisions; confirms actions and ownership.
* **Digital:** Uses collaboration tools and quality systems reliably; prepares and presents Pareto and trend views to support decision‑making.

ABOUT OLANDER  


The Olander family of companies are a full\-line distributor of standard and metric fasteners, including commercial and specialty fasteners, precision hardware, electromechanical components, tools, adhesives, and wire management products. We started off serving Silicon Valley in 1962\. Today, we have customers in more than 45 countries.  


JOB SUMMARY  


Carry out incoming and outgoing material quality inspections and work with Purchasing and Warehouse Management for disposition of non\-conformance material/parts accordingly. Perform incoming quality assurance activities and product quality inspections and support quality related improvement activities and initiatives.  


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS  


Perform receiving inspections on purchase orders, customer RMA’s, Secondary Process orders, and transfers from other company locations per company procedures.  
Count and inspect incoming inventories per quality inspection procedures.  
Verify the completeness of, scan, and save all Certs, Specs, and any quality related documents.  
Monitor and uphold the integrity of the company’s lot traceability and the manufacturer’s lot  
traceability when possible.  
Understand how and when to use all Quality Assurance instruments.  
Coordinate with Purchasing to assist in the timely resolution of all material in Quarantine.  
As directed, train new personnel in the Inspection procedures outlined in The CORE system.  
As directed, train new personnel in the appropriate use and care of all Quality Assurance  


Maintain all Quality Assurance instrumentation and tools  
Assist with customer quality surveys and quality audits when requested  
Exercise professional judgment in all activities  
Assist in monitoring the calibration schedule for gages and calipers and communicate need to  
prepare for calibration of main set by requesting to receive the substitution set from another office location.  
Responsible for returning substitution set to other office location upon completion and return of calibrated main set.  
Assist Quality Manager and Sales Managers in responding to customer SCAR requests.  
Work collaboratively with the Warehouse Manager, Sales Manager, and Purchasing Manager  
to address any Quality Assurance issues or projects, including but not limited to quality surveys and quality audits.  
Give input on updates and maintenance of the Quality Assurance Manual as needed  
Maintain ability and be available to perform all Receiving functions outside of QA as time allows.  


QUALIFICATIONS  


Education: High School Diploma or equivalent required.  
Minimum 5 years’ experience as a quality inspector in a manufacturing or fastener environment desired.

Familiarity with ISO 9001 and AS9100D requirements.  
Proficiency in using warehouse management system and software, (i.e., Epicor/P21\).

Experience using Keyence IMX\-1330 inspection system is highly desirable.  
Experience with Autodesk Fusion 360 highly desirable.  
Experience using Babbu P1s 3D printer and Bambu Studio highly desirable.  
Familiarity with CORE compliance software a plus.  
Ability to exercise good judgement while working independently and with a team.  
Self\-motivated with a strong work ethic, dependable and reliable.  
Excellent communication and customer service skills, as well as excellent written and verbal communication skills.  
Strong attention to details.  


PHYSICAL DEMANDS  


Requires extended periods of standing  
Able to read documents, computer screens, and make entries into the software system  
May require extensive walking  
Must be able to lift and transfer up to 50lbs on a continuous basis  
Must be able to perform mathematical calculations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division).  


The information contained herein is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and qualifications required of individuals performing the job. Management has the discretion to revise, assign, or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time.  


Base Salary: $55,000 to $65,000 annual – DOE. This position is also eligible for the Company’s Incentive/Bonus plan.

**Company introduction:**



Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS) is a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care.



The Company is headquartered in London, UK, with a U.S. office in New Jersey. We believe mental health patients deserve the possibility of a better future. Our initial focus is developing COMP360 psilocybin, a proprietary, investigational, synthetic psilocybin treatment under evaluation for treatment\-resistant depression (TRD) and post\-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). COMP360 is a potentially first\-in\-class treatment and has Breakthrough Therapy designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), as well as Innovative Licensing and Access Pathway (ILAP) designation in the UK for TRD.



We are leading the world's largest classic psychedelic clinical program in TRD, and building upon that robust foundation, we are executing a late\-stage trial evaluating COMP360 for PTSD, another condition with high unmet need. jobs.description:
**About Us**

  

Medical data exchange is one of the biggest unsolved problems in US healthcare. If you've spent any real time in the healthcare system, you've felt it, and it only gets worse the sicker and older you get. Metriport exists to fix that. We connect to the data sources the healthcare providers of tomorrow need, take raw data that's unusable in its source form, and turn it into a single clean format that care teams, and their agents, actually use to improve outcomes. Record retrieval across thousands of legacy systems and antiquated data pipes that used to take weeks now takes seconds. Clinicians walk into appointments with the full patient picture already in hand, and that speed can mean spotting a condition early enough to actually treat it.


We're not a healthcare company. We're a technology company that happens to operate in healthcare, and we build every layer ourselves: connect, transform, and insight. Legacy EHRs were built to get providers paid, not to serve the clinical experience. We're building what should have existed instead: the system of record for all of US healthcare. We started in data exchange. Today we compete with the largest data platforms in the space. Tomorrow we will be the infrastructure layer healthcare runs on.


We’ve raised $28\.4 million from top\-tier VCs (including Matrix, ARTIS and Y Combinator), found product\-market fit (multi\-million dollar ARR, 100\+ customers including Amazon One Medical, Circle Medical, Color Health, and Strive Health), and have years of runway ahead of us. If you’ve had a good healthcare experience in the past few years, there’s a good chance Metriport was behind it. That’s the version of healthcare we want people to not just expect, but demand. Join us and build the future.  

  

**About You**

We're a small, high\-output team, mostly former founders including YC alumni, and we operate with real autonomy and almost no bureaucracy. We hire on competence, not pedigree. Leaders are in the office six days a week, and we generally expect the team to be available six days a week too. Not because we count hours, but because there's always more wood to chop when revolutionizing how tomorrow’s healthcare providers deliver care to their patients today. We trust our team to take the time off they need and we've never said no to a time off request.  

  

You have an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong sense of ownership. You don't wait to be told what's broken. Instead, you believe you can figure out any problem that lands in your lap even outside your exact domain. When someone scopes something for three weeks, you ask why it can't be done in three days, and you also know the difference between shipping a fast v0 and cutting a corner that comes back to bite you. You walk the tightrope between craft and speed without falling off either side.

**The Role**


We’re looking for an Office Manager / Executive Assistant to keep our SF office running and support our leadership team. This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role with direct impact on how we operate day\-to\-day. You’ll be in our SF office Monday through Friday.


You’ll split your time roughly equally between office operations and executive support with cross\-functional opportunities. If you’re energized by building systems from scratch, thrive when no two days look the same, and want a path into People / HR as the company scales—this role was built for you.

**Office Management**

* Own the SF office experience end\-to\-end: supplies, snacks, equipment, vendors, and facilities
* Lead office build\-out initiatives as we grow: coordinate with contractors, landlord, and vendors
* Plan and execute internal events (team offsites, all\-hands, celebrations, customer visits)
* Manage vendor relationships and negotiate contracts for office services
* Maintain operational docs and processes in Notion; coordinate team communication in Slack and Linear
* Support onboarding logistics for new hires and assist with People / HR projects over time

**Recruiting coordination and sourcing**

* Work with our internal recruiter on sourcing and screening candidates
* Build and maintain sourcing funnels, craft personalized messages, and track response rates
* Schedule and coordinate initial calls with candidates and follow\-up meetings between candidates and hiring managers

**Executive Support**

* Manage complex calendars for both leaders: scheduling internal meetings, external calls, and personal appointments across time zones
* Coordinate domestic travel: flights, hotels, ground transport, and itineraries
* Track follow\-ups, action items, and commitments so nothing falls through the cracks
* Draft and send communications on behalf of leadership as needed
* Assist with ad hoc research, vendor outreach, and special projects

**Requirements**

* **Experience:** 1–2\+ years as an Office Manager, Executive Assistant, or similar role at an early\-stage startup
* **Presence:** Based in San Francisco; available in\-office 5 days per week (Monday\-Friday mornings)
* **Startup DNA:** You’re comfortable with ambiguity, can prioritize across competing demands without hand\-holding, and enjoy building things from scratch
* **Organized by default:** You maintain clean systems for calendars, tasks, and follow\-ups without being reminded
* **Strong communicator:** Clear and professional in writing and in\-person; comfortable interfacing directly with founders and external partners
* **Proactive:** You identify problems before they surface and propose solutions, not just questions
* **Tool\-savvy:** Proficient with Notion, Slack, and Google Workspace; bonus if you’ve used Linear

**Preferred:** Interest in growing into a People/HR Operations role as Metriport scales
