jobs.title: Sales Operations and Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Have you been looking for a company that you can get behind and feel good about the impact it has on sustainability and recycling efforts? Quest is a full\-service environmental consulting and management group supporting the efforts of Fortune 500 companies seeking to maximize profits and mitigate risks and minimize their ecological footprints.

If you want an opportunity where your efforts make an impact, Quest has an opportunity for you. The ideal person must be able to multi\-task, work independently and have strong attention to detail while being able to collaboratively communicate across departments.

**Why Work at Quest?**  
First off, we practice what we preach. We focus every day on recycling, reusing and repurposing where we can, and being socially responsible.

Finally, we are just a modern, FUN and collaborative work environment. We’re a smaller company that provides opportunities for employees to advance within the company, so there is always room to grow. We offer a casual business environment (so, you can wear jeans), great incentives and rewards with a quarterly recognition program.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Sales Operations \& Implementation Manager is responsible for aligning strategic sales initiatives with operational execution, guiding opportunities through the sales pipeline to implementation and live launch. This role combines sales operations support for the National Sales Managers (NSMs) with hands\-on project management of new client and wallet share implementations, ensuring stage\-gate requirements are met before deals progress and that established deadlines are met at each pipeline stage through launch.

The Manager oversees sales processes, CRM utilization, lead board maintenance, sales enablement, and reporting functions, and serves as the primary point of coordination between Sales, Business Solutions, Vendor Relations, and Key Accounts throughout the sales\-to\-launch lifecycle.

This role requires strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent implementation timelines, along with the cross\-functional relationship\-building skills to keep deals and launches on track across Sales, Business Solutions, Vendor Relations, Key Accounts, and Operations.

**ROLE DESCRIPTION**

* **Sales Process \& CRM Management:** Supports the SVP of Sales and Marketing in designing and maintaining SOPs for all sales activities, leads onboarding and CRM training for new NSMs, and builds and optimizes dashboards for executive reporting, individual sales rep performance, and pipeline/funnel tracking.
* **Lead Management \& Sales Enablement:** Owns and manages the sales lead board, partnering with Marketing on lead generation strategy and tracking lead performance and conversion metrics. Leads sales enablement efforts — training, tools, and resources — that support NSM effectiveness, and partners closely with NSMs to prioritize outreach and target account alignment.
* **Pipeline Stage\-Gate Ownership:** Establishes and maintains stage\-gate criteria for each phase of the sales pipeline. Acts as the opportunity validator, ensuring required documentation and approvals — including signed MNDA, signed LOA where applicable, site lists, and invoices/spend data — are complete before an opportunity advances to the next stage.
* **Vendor Pricing \& Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Partners closely with Business Solutions and Vendor Relations to ensure vendor pricing and bids are received on timeto support proposal and closing timelines, and coordinates with Key Accounts and other stakeholders to confirm deal readiness at each stage gate.
* **Implementation \& Launch Project Management:** Serves as project manager for new client and wallet share implementations, owning the timeline from signed contract through live launch. Builds and maintains implementation project plans, establishing milestones, deadlines, and owners for each workstream, and proactively identifies and resolves risks to keep launches on track.
* **Client Handoff \& Launch Support:** Coordinates cross\-functionally with Business Solutions, Vendor Relations, Key Accounts, and Operations throughout implementation, and confirms a smooth transition to Key Accounts and Operations post\-launch to ensure continuity of service and a positive client experience.
* **Cross\-Departmental Collaboration:** Actively participates in internal meetings related to sales performance, process optimization, and strategic initiatives, and contributes to internal enablement by sharing insights, best practices, and feedback across teams.

**ROLE COMPETENCIES**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Implementation, Project Management, or a related field.
* Strong project management skills, with proven ability to manage multiple concurrent implementation timelines and cross\-functional workstreams.
* Proven ability to manage and improve sales systems, processes, and cross\-functional workflows.
* Demonstrated success in coaching, supporting, and guiding team members in a high\-performance sales environment.
* Proficient with CRM, sales engagement, and project management platforms/tools.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data\-driven recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to influence and collaborate across departments, including Business Solutions, Vendor Relations, and Key Accounts.
* Experience developing SOPs, performance dashboards, and sales/implementation reports for both executive and team\-level use.
* Skilled in lead management processes, pipeline optimization, and stage\-gate/deal qualification strategies.
* Highly organized with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with RFP identification/qualification and vendor pricing or bid processes

Our medical imaging solutions streamline the flow of information, simplifying complex processes, maximizing efficiencies, and shining a light on the unknown. We empower physicians to get patients the answers they need faster and improve outcomes for everyone. With more accessible imaging, we are getting patients out of the dark.


Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 800 employees located in offices across four countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. Intelerad’s modern enterprise solutions have been acknowledged by a Best in KLAS recognition, ranking \#1 for PACS Europe UK/Ireland in the 2026 Best in KLAS: Global Software (Non\-US) report.

 **Job Description**  

Intelerad is seeking a Technical Implementation Specialist II to lead the delivery of complex technical and workflow implementation services for our Radiology Healthcare IT solutions. Operating with increased autonomy, you will design integration workflows, configure and validate enterprise systems, and guide clients through complex go\-lives. You will collaborate cross\-functionally with Project Management, Applications, and Workflow teams, and will contribute to continuous improvement by sharing implementation insights across the organization.


InteleShare is Intelerad’s medical image exchange platform, used by healthcare organizations to securely share imaging studies and related clinical information across facilities, providers, and care networks. This role will be part of the Technical Services group for the InteleShare team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead HL7/DICOM integration design, configuration, and deployment for complex client environments, ensuring alignment with clinical goals and Intelerad best practices.
* Diagnose and resolve advanced technical and workflow issues across applications, integrations, and infrastructure, both remotely and on\-site.
* Partner with Project Management to drive system integration and functionality milestones, providing regular status updates to clients and third\-party vendors.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:*** BA/BS degree preferred
* 1 \- 3 years experience in an implementation, professional services role (with software tech experience), or other clinical research experience
* *Excellent* writing, interpersonal, organizational and time management skills
* Strong PC/Mac skills including proficiency with Office Suite/G Suite tools
* Ability to work independently yet support team responsibilities and goals
* High integrity and positive can\-do attitude
* Familiarity with Live Chat, Slack and project management tools (JIRA/Confluence)
* Experience with Looker a plus
* Prior work experience in, healthcare, SAAS, clinical research or academia
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) language skills strongly preferred

  

Join us at CRIO and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to revolutionizing the clinical research industry. This position is in GE Healthcare's MIM Software business which makes vendor\-neutral imaging software to standardize your workflow and simplify increasingly complex clinical scenarios. Leading global healthcare organizations use MIM® to give patients more precise, personalized care.  

  

https://www.mimsoftware.com/

We are looking for candidates with a strong track record of delivering exceptional results with a patient focus, developing deep \& strategic account relationships, and executing strategic account plans.

* Manage customer accounts both remotely and on\-site

**What You’ll Need:**

jobs.description:
**Overview**

Are you passionate about making a transformative difference in the lives of individuals navigating mental health challenges? We are on the lookout for a dedicated and empathetic Case Manager/Mental Health Worker to assume a pivotal role in providing essential support and care to those seeking help.

**Position Overview:**

As an integral part of our team, you will hold a key position responsible for delivering professional case management services. Our organization is committed to making a lasting impact on individuals' lives, empowering them to overcome mental health challenges and lead fulfilling lives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Conduct thorough assessments and management services, utilizing validated rating scales. Craft individualized behavioral healthcare plans that address behavioral/psychiatric concerns. Adapt plans for patients showing insufficient progress or experiencing changes in their condition. Provide concise psychosocial interventions.

Collaborate closely with the care team and maintain accurate records in the registry. All activities are conducted in consultation with the psychiatric consultant.

While primarily a remote position, availability for in\-person service provision to beneficiaries is required. Cultivate lasting relationships with beneficiaries and foster a collaborative, integrated rapport with the broader care team.

Serve as a patient advocate within the treatment team, offering indirect support and acting as a liaison on their behalf.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).

A minimum of 2 years of experience in a behavioral health setting.

Licensed Social Worker (LSW).

In\-depth understanding of various mental health conditions, therapeutic interventions, and crisis management techniques.

Become an essential part of our endeavor to create a supportive and empowering environment that fosters positive change in the lives of those we serve. jobs.description:
**See your work in a new light.**
---------------------------------



At LUX Infusion, we're reimagining infusion care to be more human, supportive, and connected. Inspired by *lux*—meaning light \- we guide patients, providers, and partners through complex therapies with clarity, compassion, and confidence.



As a clinician\-led, U.S.\-based organization, we put people first \- helping patients feel seen and supported through faster therapy starts, dedicated care coordination, and meaningful collaboration. Our commitment to inclusion, diversity, equity, and advancement (IDEA) is central to our culture, ensuring every team member feels valued and empowered to make a difference.

  


We're looking for a **Patient Access Liaison Lead** who wants their work to *mean something* — someone who brings empathy, precision, and follow‑through to protecting patients' ongoing access to care.


**Location: REMOTE \- Kansas City, KS or USA**  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, **8:30 AM–5:00 PM CST or EST**



**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------



As a key member of the Intake team, a Patient Access Liaison (PAL) Lead will be responsible for directing and overseeing their team toward the common goal of securing authorization and on\-boarding new patients. PAL Lead will act as PAL\- Pending for their aligned sales representatives and will serve as the primary contact to a referral source (prescriber, provider, healthcare center, system, and/or practice), the patient for whom the referral is for, and the field\-based sales representative associated with the referral source account. In this role, the PAL Lead will be responsible for navigating a new prescription via a referral from a referral source through the necessary steps to determine whether it can be serviced in the BioMatrix network of pharmacies.



In addition to the PAL\- Pending duties, PAL Lead will also assist in ensuring the team is achieving service level agreements, on\-boarding new cases to meet team goals, being a resource for escalations and further escalating cases as appropriate. This role will work closely with data entry, reimbursement, nurse coordination, revenue cycle management and pharmacy operations team members supporting various stages of the intake and pharmacy management processes and will understand the case status and next steps for each referral they are responsible for supporting.



In this role, your work will:


* Help patients remain on therapy without delays or disruption
* Provide clarity and reassurance during insurance or coverage changes
* Support care teams through accurate documentation and proactive communication


Every follow‑up helps safeguard a patient's ability to continue treatment with confidence.



**What You'll Do**
------------------


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**



In this role, you will:


* Lead team toward common goals by providing support and guidance to PALs and Reimbursement Specialists
* Monitor CareTend queues based on last events to ensure work is progressing efficiently
* Escalate cases as needed to Intake Escalations Supervisor or upper management as needed for additional review or support
* Monitor and manage team productivity and service level agreements Ensure team members are grasping and implementing any new processes
* Participate in team development/ process improvement discussions as needed
* Manage team members' schedule, time off, quality of work and any other personnel or performance issues
* Build relationships with assigned referral sources and associated BioMatrix field representatives through communication and coordination with key personnel responsible for pharmacy referral activities within the healthcare setting
* Serve as point of contact to referral source and keep necessary referral source personnel well informed of the status of referrals sent to BioMatrix for service
* Follow\-up with referral source, patient, and/or caregiver to collect all required information and data sets needed to support the referral process activities (including but not limited to patient demographic, pharmacy/medical benefits, clinical history, and/or prescription details)
* Work closely with Reimbursement Specialists and conveys outcomes of benefit investigation activities with patient when it comes to patient out of pocket costs, financial responsibility, and financial assistance options for patient support consideration
* Work closely and communicate with Nurse Coordination team for those patients who intend to move forward with service and require in\-home nurse care to be scheduled and organized around prescription fulfillment and shipping
* Work closely and communicate with Nurse Coordination team for those patients who intend to move forward with service and require in\-home nurse care to be scheduled and organized around prescription fulfillment and shipping
* Work closely and communicate with Pharmacy operations team members ensuring clinical and fulfillment resources have everything they need to successfully support the on\-boarding and on\-going fulfillment for a new patient referral/prescription
* Produce written documentation representing all provider, patient, caregiver, and/or field team updates and communications in necessary systems of record

jobs.title: Channel Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future\-proof their businesses. Through real\-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via Calix One — our cloud\-first, AI\-powered platform — CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. Calix One brings together the automation of everything and the experience of one, empowering customers to deliver differentiated subscriber experiences while driving acquisition, loyalty, and revenue growth. This is the Calix mission: to enable CSPs of all sizes to simplify, innovate, and grow, strengthening both their businesses and the communities they serve.
  

  

We’re at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the broadband industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential, and connect underserved communities with unrivaled digital experiences.
Calix delivers a broadband platform and managed services that enable our customers and partners to improve life one community at a time. We’re at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the industry and Calix is making strategic investments to establish managed business solutions as a major growth engine. To achieve this, Calix is forming a dedicated, cross\-functional Managed Business team responsible for defining not only the market strategy, but the complete customer and operational models required to scale profitably. Join us as we innovate, help our customers/partners reach their potential, and connect with unrivaled digital experiences.


It is an exciting time to join Calix as we build a dedicated Managed Business team focused on turning strategic market opportunity into scalable growth. The Channel Enablement Manager is responsible for designing and executing scalable enablement programs that prepare partners to successfully position and sell Calix Managed Business solutions. This role supports Managed Service Provider partners through structured, virtual or in\-person or self\-led training programs. Success is measured through partner readiness, certifications, time to first deal, and adoption of partner tools and resources.

**Core Responsibilities \& Tasks:**
-----------------------------------

* Design and implement partner enablement onboarding programs that accelerate MSP partner readiness to market and sell Calix solutions
* Build and scale training and certification programs across MSP partners for Calix solutions
* Develop and deliver in\-person and virtual workshops for MSP sellers
* Develop structured, role\-based enablement pathways for MSP partner sellers and marketers
* Create enablement assets including training modules, playbooks, onboarding kits, and solution guides
* Enable partners on the Calix Partner Program including structure, benefits, and engagement models
* Drive adoption of partner tools and platforms such as PRM systems and learning platforms
* Partner with sales, success, product marketing, and partner marketing to align enablement with go\-to\-market priorities
* Track and report on enablement success metrics including certifications, readiness, time to first deal, and tool adoption
* Continuously refine programs based on partner feedback and performance insights
* Establish a repeatable enablement framework that scales across a growing partner ecosystem

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* 5\-8\+ years of experience in partner enablement, sales enablement, channel programs, or related roles in enterprise technology
* Experience building and scaling training, onboarding, or certification programs
* Proven track record creating innovative partner enablement programs for MSPs targeting Multi Dwelling Units, Venues, SMB, and Hospitality.
* Strong strategic planning and program leadership capabilities with experience influencing large cross\-functional organizations.
* Relevant knowledge of: WiFi, roaming, networking, operations and management, mobile apps and portals, and property management systems.
* Strong understanding of MSP, VAR, or channel partner business models
* Experience developing structured learning programs and enablement content
* Experience driving adoption of partner tools such as PRM, LMS, or enablement platforms
* Strong communication, collaboration, and program management skills
* Ability to translate complex technical solutions into clear and actionable partner training

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building or managing partner certification programs
* Experience working with partner program structures
* Experience launching enablement programs for new products
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Education, or related field; advanced degree preferred

jobs.description:
**Seamless** delivers the world’s best sales leads. Through our product, we help sales teams maximize revenue, increase sales, and easily acquire their total addressable market using artificial intelligence; by development of a robust real\-time contact and company search engine as well as a suite of technically\-advanced tools to support sales and lead generation. We have been recognized as one of Ohio’s fastest growing companies and have been recently ranked No. 7 in LinkedIn's Top 50 Startups of 2022, featured in Forbes as \#1 Software company in Ohio in 2022, and on G2’s “Top 100 Highest Satisfaction Products for 2022” list!

  

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Visa Sponsorship is not included in our hiring package. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

 **The Opportunity**


As a **Mid\-Market Customer Success Manager at Seamless.AI**, you will own the retention, engagement, and growth of a portfolio of Mid\-Market customers. You will serve as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact, helping customers maximize the value of Seamless.AI while proactively identifying churn risks, driving adoption, and uncovering expansion opportunities.


This role combines **customer success, strategic account management, and consultative selling**. You will leverage high\-touch and tech\-touch engagement to efficiently manage a large book of business while partnering with Sales, Support, Product, and other teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own relationships across an assigned Mid\-Market book of business and serve as the primary customer point of contact.
* Proactively monitor customer health, engagement, adoption, and organizational changes to identify and mitigate churn risk.
* Lead renewal strategies and negotiations to maximize retention.
* Develop account strategies to increase product adoption, customer value, and lifetime value.
* Identify and pursue expansion opportunities in partnership with Sales.
* Build trusted relationships and understand customers' business goals, challenges, and growth plans.
* Conduct proactive outreach using a combination of high\-touch and tech\-touch engagement.
* Manage customer escalations and coordinate timely resolution across internal teams.
* Capture and communicate actionable customer feedback to leadership and Product.
* Maintain accurate account, activity, and renewal information in Salesforce.
* Stay current on Seamless.AI products and industry trends to provide knowledgeable, consultative guidance.

**Skills \& Requirements**

* 2–3\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or a related customer\-facing role, preferably in SaaS or technology.

jobs.description:
**Overview of Job Function**

The Manager of Customer Success leads a team of Customer Success Managers responsible for driving adoption, value realization, retention, and expansion across a defined portfolio of Verint customers. This role owns the operating rhythm for the team, including renewal readiness, CSQL pipeline generation, customer health management, and playbook execution. The Manager is accountable for team\-level revenue outcomes (revenue retention, renewal rates, and expansion pipeline) and for developing CSMs into high\-performing customer advocates. This role partners cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Professional Services to ensure customers realize measurable value from Verint's platform.


**Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership \& Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers across varying experience levels.
* Own the full people management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, development plans, and performance management.
* Establish and run a consistent team operating rhythm, including account health reviews, forecast calls, account planning sessions, and strategy discussions.
* Set clear expectations for CSM activity, output quality, and customer outcomes; hold the team accountable to those standards.
* Build team capabilities through structured coaching on executive engagement, business review delivery, value realization storytelling, and expansion identification.
* Manage team capacity and workload distribution to ensure balanced account coverage.

**Revenue Ownership \& Customer Outcomes**

* Own team\-level targets for revenue retention, and CSQL\-generated expansion pipeline.
* Hold the team accountable for documenting customer outcomes and value realization, ensuring success stories and measurable results are captured and shared.
* Drive CSM execution against renewal timelines, ensuring early risk identification and proactive intervention.
* Oversee CSQL pipeline generation and qualification, ensuring the team identifies and advances expansion opportunities through the defined approval and staging process.
* Monitor customer health scores, adoption metrics, and risk indicators at the portfolio level; take action when trends signal churn or contraction risk.
* Ensure consistent execution of scheduled customer check\-ins, success plans, and periodic business reviews across the team's portfolio.

**Customer Engagement \& Escalation Management**

* Serve as the escalation point for at\-risk accounts, engaging directly with customer executives when needed to resolve issues and protect revenue.
* Join strategic customer meetings, executive business reviews, and renewal conversations to reinforce Verint's commitment and value.
* Coach CSMs on building and maintaining multi\-threaded relationships with customer stakeholders, including economic buyers and operational sponsors.
* Ensure timely identification, documentation, and resolution of customer concerns across the team.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Represent the voice of the customer in cross\-functional forums with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Professional Services.
* Partner with Sales leadership on account strategy alignment, handoff processes, and joint renewal/expansion planning.
* Provide structured product feedback to Product teams based on aggregated customer input and adoption data.
* Coordinate with Professional Services and Support to ensure delivery expectations align with customer goals.

**Process Ownership \& Operational Excellence**

* Own playbook execution and iteration for the team, ensuring CSMs follow established engagement models, success planning frameworks, and escalation protocols.
* Utilize CS platform tools and dashboards (e.g., Totango) to track customer health, adoption trends, and team performance.
* Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvement in workflows, templates, and reporting to increase team efficiency and consistency.
* Deliver accurate renewal and expansion forecasts to leadership on a regular cadence.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 4\+ years of people management experience leading customer\-facing teams, with 6\+ years of overall experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related function.
* Demonstrated experience managing a team accountable for a book of business, including renewal and expansion targets.
* Working knowledge of CS platforms and tooling (e.g., Totango, Gainsight) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).
* Proficiency in using data, dashboards, and health scoring frameworks to manage customer portfolios and drive team actions.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and relationship\-building skills with the ability to engage customer executives.
* Experience operating in a cross\-functional, matrixed environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize across multiple accounts, team members, and competing demands.
* Ability to travel up to 20% of the time.
* Successful completion of a background screening process including, but not limited to, employment verifications, criminal search, OFAC, SS Verification, as well as credit and drug screening, where applicable and in accordance with federal and local regulations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in workforce management, customer experience, or enterprise SaaS environments.
* Track record of improving net revenue retention or gross renewal rates within a managed portfolio.
* Familiarity with customer segmentation models and tiered engagement strategies.
* Background in coaching and developing Customer Success professionals.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
###### **A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US**


We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

#### **About Foundant**


At Foundant, we build mission\-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.


We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of \~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

#### **Where You’ll Work:**

* As a remote\-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
* With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
##### ***What******You’ll******Do:***

* You'll build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients across our portfolio, serving as a strategic advisor and advocate — because renewals are built on relationships, not just contracts
* You'll own the renewal process end to end and proactively identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities aligned with client goals and product capabilities
* You'll track and assess client engagement, satisfaction, and usage metrics to ensure high retention and get ahead of churn risk
* You'll partner closely with Customer Success to align on client needs, share feedback, and coordinate efforts that drive client success — because we do more good when we work together
* You'll develop account plans for key clients, outlining growth strategies, risk mitigation, and engagement tactics
* You'll maintain a deep understanding of Foundant, GivingData, and SmartSimple offerings so you can guide clients toward the solutions and outcomes that matter most to their mission
* Other duties as assigned

##### ***What******You’ll******Need:***

* 3\+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or a related role in SaaS or technology environments
* A proven track record of managing renewals and driving upsell/cross\-sell outcomes
* Experience working cross\-functionally in a fast\-paced, client\-centric environment
* Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and customer success platforms
* Must be legally eligible to work in Canada or the United States

**Preferred:**

* Experience in the nonprofit, philanthropic, or government sectors
* Understanding of SaaS metrics and client health scoring

##### ***What******You’ll******Bring to our Team Dynamics:***

* **Adaptive Achievement:** Owns a full renewal pipeline independently — juggling multiple accounts and deadlines, and adapting account plans as client needs and priorities shift
* **Productive Collaboration:** Builds trusted, cross\-functional relationships with Customer Success and other internal teams to keep client outcomes aligned, because we do more good together
* **Service Orientation:** Anticipates client needs before renewal conversations happen, understanding that a client's success is what makes the relationship — and the business — sustainable
* **Business Insight:** Understands how Foundant, GivingData, and SmartSimple solutions drive measurable outcomes for organizations in the philanthropic and social good sector, and uses that knowledge to identify genuine upsell and cross\-sell opportunities

##### ***Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:***

* At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not\-for\-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real\-world change.
* We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
* With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well\-being and professional success.
* We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
* As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
* You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
* Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

  

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants

jobs.title: Technical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About MD Integrations**


At **MD Integrations**, we partner with digital health brands to power clinical care at scale. We specialize in men's and women’s health, dermatology, endocrinology, and weight management, offering telehealth solutions that help patients receive expert, personalized care—all from the comfort of their home. Join our team and be part of the movement to make specialty care more accessible and impactful.

 **MD Integrations is an equal opportunity employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are unable to support US visa sponsorship at this time.

  

The Technical Implementation Specialist is the central point of contact and technical liaison for MDI customers in active implementation and supporting existing customers as they expand their integration offerings. You’ll lead the technical implementation process from kickoff to go\-live, mapping and configuring API connections, reviewing logs, and troubleshooting issues to keep integrations on track.


This role is ideal for someone technically literate and highly comfortable working with APIs who enjoys problem\-solving, learning new systems, and explaining complex concepts clearly to non\-technical customers. This is not a software engineering role: you won’t be writing production code, but you will need to be confident configuring, testing, and debugging API connections independently. You’ll partner closely with the partner success and engineering teams, escalating clearly documented issues when they’re beyond the scope of this role.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Serve as the technical point of contact for new customers throughout implementation, and for existing customers expanding their integration footprint, guiding each engagement from kickoff through go\-live.
* Lead the end\-to\-end technical implementation process, mapping and configuring API connections with customers and validating setup over screen share in real time. The average implementation timeline is days, not months.
* Monitor logs, dashboards, and tools like Postman to identify when APIs are misconfigured or behaving unexpectedly, and independently resolve the majority of issues without engineering involvement.
* Draft clear technical documentation for each issue encountered, including root cause, steps taken, and resolution, to build a reliable internal record and knowledge base.
* Escalate unresolved or complex issues to engineering with well\-documented context, ensuring a smooth handoff and minimal back\-and\-forth.
* Translate customer inquiries and data needs into clear technical tasks and configuration notes, acting as the bridge between customer expectations and technical execution.
* Partner with the Partner Success Managers and Clinical Support teams to align technical capabilities with customer expectations throughout the relationship.
* Identify recurring issues or friction points across implementations and recommend ways to simplify, document, or automate the process.
* Maintain a high level of responsiveness, ownership, and customer empathy across both the finite implementation period and ongoing expansion work.

**Success Looks Like…**
-----------------------

* Quick integration timelines driving a seamless go\-live.
* High customer satisfaction scores during integration and beyond.
* Low number of escalations needing hands\-on engineering resources.
* Accuracy and completeness of documentation.
* Responsiveness and collaboration across technical and customer teams.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 3\+ years’ experience in a customer\-facing technical support or implementation role with an emphasis on API\-driven applications. Must be comfortable working with customers’ technical teams live, troubleshooting on video calls.
* Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, and HTTP status codes; comfortable reading logs and API documentation to identify root cause and resolve configuration issues without engineering support.
* Familiarity with data mapping, payload structures, or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript, or SQL).
* Experience using tools such as HubSpot, Postman or equivalent for troubleshooting and testing API calls.
* Technically\-savvy and able to communicate technical concepts and processes to both technical and non\-technical users. This is a technical support/implementation role, not a software development role, so you won’t be writing production code, but you should be able to independently resolve the majority of configuration and integration issues you encounter.
* Experience documenting integration processes or producing customer\-facing support materials for internal and external use including workflows, process diagrams and SOPs.
* High attention to detail and organization; able to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Demonstrated curiosity and ability to learn new systems, data flows, and integration logic quickly.
* Customer\-first mindset: you thrive in helping customers solve problems and find clarity.
* Experience in SaaS or healthcare technology integrations, a plus.

 **What We Offer**

* **Competitive Salary:** The targeted range for this mid\-level position is $72,500 \- $85,000 per year, DOE.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Our benefits package includes health, dental, and vision insurance with generous subsidy, company\-covered life and disability insurance, and 401(k) with match for full\-time, US\-based employees.
* **Professional Development Opportunities:** We are committed to investing in our employees' professional development and offer a variety of on the job training and growth opportunities.
* **Flexible Work Arrangements:** We are a fully remote team who collaborate both synchronously and asynchronously to achieve the best outcomes.
* **Collaborative and Supportive Work Environment:** We foster a collaborative and supportive work environme

ForumWithin helps companies build stronger, more connected cultures through peer groups, executive coaching, and team facilitation. We take the peer\-forum model that's long powered CEO networks like YPO and EO and bring it inside organizations, creating small, confidential groups where employees and leaders can talk openly about real challenges, build trust, and grow their emotional intelligence, communication, and leadership.

Right now, most of our work centers on building peer groups within companies, cross\-functional, department\-level, or leadership cohorts that meet regularly with a trained facilitator to work through real workplace dynamics like accountability, collaboration, and communication across teams. We pair that with one\-on\-one executive coaching and hands\-on team facilitation, all aimed at the same outcome: helping people have better conversations at work, build genuine trust with the people around them, and lead with more self\-awareness. We're a small, close\-knit team, and we're looking for someone who thrives on keeping the behind\-the\-scenes systems running smoothly so the rest of us can focus on the people we serve.

We're hiring an Operations Coordinator to help our small team stay organized, on schedule, and on top of client communication. jobs.title: National Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Mojave Energy Systems, Inc.**



Mojave is changing the nature of air conditioning. Air conditioning consumes \~9% of total global electricity production and results in the emissions of 1 billion tons of carbon dioxide annually. It is time for a change, and Mojave’s liquid desiccant air conditioning systems are doing just that. If you want to change the world, starting with the world of air conditioning, then you may belong at Mojave. We are looking for purpose\-driven team members who enjoy problem solving, teamwork, and personal growth to join our venture\-backed company.



We are seeking a National Account Executive to join the sales organization at Mojave Energy Systems, reporting to our VP of Sales. This remote position is responsible for selling Mojave systems directly to building owners, consulting engineers, and design\-build contractors \- leading with deep expertise and an activatable network in a single vertical (grocery, hospitality, industrial, or education), with national account responsibility for that vertical. The compensation package for this role includes a base salary \& commission structure.

  


**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**



This is a direct\-selling role. You will carry a number, and you will hit it by finding latent load problems in buildings and applications you already understand and building the case for Mojave's systems as the solution. The successful candidate will "get in at the ground floor" of our business and help establish our first reference installations in their vertical.

  



This is a national role. While Mojave sells into grocery, hospitality, industrial, and education, we expect this hire to lead with deep expertise and an activatable network in one of these verticals, and to own that vertical nationally from day one.

  



We are looking for a technical seller who already knows how buildings in their vertical are designed, bid, and bought — and who is already known and trusted there. In an early market, an established reputation in a vertical is the shortest path to a qualified pipeline. Yours will be put to work immediately.

  


**RESPONSIBILITIES**

  


* Own direct sales in your assigned vertical end to end: prospecting, qualification, technical development, negotiation, and close.
* Sell to end users and their design teams within your vertical — e.g., grocery chains, hotel brands and management companies, industrial plants, or school districts and universities, depending on assignment.
* Activate your existing network to generate qualified opportunities in your first 90 days.
* Manage a pipeline in CRM software (zoho.com) to achieve assigned sales revenue targets.
* Navigate the buying process specific to your vertical: national account programs and construction standards, capital planning and plant engineering, or bond funding, public procurement cycles, and performance\-contracting routes.
* Drive Mojave to Basis of Design with consulting engineers, design\-build contractors, and owner engineering standards groups.
* Perform load and psychrometric analysis, equipment selection, and energy and life\-cycle cost comparisons against conventional DX, DOAS, and competing desiccant systems.
* Assist with estimates, quoting, equipment selections, and submittals as required.
* Translate vertical\-specific requirements into a concrete value proposition — e.g., store humidity setpoints and refrigeration case load in grocery, guest comfort and mold risk in hospitality, process humidity control in industrial, or ventilation and shoulder\-season dehumidification in schools.
* Coordinate with our Manufacturer's Rep partners where territory and account coverage overlap, and keep the channel aligned rather than in conflict.
* Act as Mojave's "Subject Matter Expert" (SME) for your vertical, internally and externally.
* Identify product gaps, capture voice of customer, and work with Product Management to prioritize and eliminate identified gaps.
* Help identify opportunities in adjacent verticals as we expand, even while your primary focus stays on your assigned vertical.
* Partner with Field Support through startup and the first season of operation so that every early account becomes a reference account.
* Perform educational presentations as required (lunch \& learns, CEUs, etc.).
* Identify and attend appropriate trade shows and vertical industry events.
* Ability to travel up to 60% of your time.

  


**Required Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related STEM field.
* 7\+ years of HVAC sales experience, including 5\+ years selling directly to owners, consulting engineers, and contractors.
* Demonstrated technical and application depth across grocery, hospitality, industrial, and/or education buildings — how loads are calculated, how equipment is specified, and how projects are bid in each.
* An established network and strong professional reputation in at least one of those four verticals, with relationships you can activate on day one.
* Ability to perform psychrometric calculations and equipment selection.
* Working command of latent load analysis, dedicated outdoor air systems (DOAS), and dehumidification strategies.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal; one\-on\-one and in groups.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail, while able to prioritize diverse responsibilities.

  


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Proven history of rapid sales growth with satisfied customers.
* Experience selling a new or unproven technology, including pilots, first installations, and the additional work of establishing credibility.
* Knowledgeable about Applied HVAC Equipment (Airside).
* Experience with liquid or solid desiccant systems, heat recovery, or other latent\-specific equipment.
* Thorough understanding of marketplace dynamics including industry trends.
* Proven capability to communicate professionally in written and verbal format across a wide audience.
* Able to work and comm

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (Northeast)
jobs.description:
Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4\.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end\-to\-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5, 000 specialists.

We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions. The Global Business Development team is like\-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems.

The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry\-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe.

Ajax Systems production includes four factories, two of which are located in Ukraine, one in Turkey and one in Vietnam. At the same time, the company's certification according to the ISO 14001 standard ensures a minimal impact of production on the environment. The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements.

The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax unwavering mission.
### **Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 5 years’ professional experience in alarm systems, video surveillance, access control and fire systems.
* Proven hands\-on experience in designing and installing video surveillance, fire alarm, or other security systems.
* Experience delivering offline and online technical training to technical audiences.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Flexible and willing to travel for business trips, trade shows, and other professional events.
* Self\-motivated and independent, with an outgoing personality and a proactive approach to work.
* NICET and ESA certifications

### **Responsibilities:**

* Conduct technical seminars, exhibitions, presentations, and webinars on Ajax products for both customers and company employees.
* Present product roadmaps and new feature updates to Ajax Systems distributors and dealers.
* Proactively manage and schedule open classes, private classes and on\-demand requests for training and support for Ajax products and technologies.
* Promote and demonstrate product solutions tailored to customer requirements; provide technical consultations and support to key clients.
* Perform market research and competitive product analysis to identify strengths, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with key company partners.
* Test product features and prepare technical documentation for new products and solutions, collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams.
* Support the sales team by following up on leads through the company’s CRM portal.
* Analyze customer needs in partnership with the sales department to identify optimal product solutions.
* Actively participate in the beta testing of new products and services providing expert feedback to product management to refine solutions.

### **We offer:**

* Competitive compensation that includes a base salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Car allowance, petrol and all business costs covered by the company
* Health \& Life insurance
* 401(k)
* Growth Opportunities
* Impactful work
* Innovative Environment


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Court Reporting Onboarding & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Remote Legal**  

At Remote Legal, our 40\-year legacy is built on the expertise of seasoned attorneys and dedicated court reporters who are passionate about transforming the legal process. We're not a flash\-in\-the\-pan tech startup—instead, we blend time\-honored legal experience with innovative technology to redefine how depositions are conducted. Our team spans legal professionals, product owners, engineers, client\-success leads, and security specialists, all collaborating seamlessly to ensure every deposition is a success. Join us, and become part of a community where rich experience meets forward\-thinking innovation, and where your talents help make the legal journey better for everyone. **About the role**  

The Reporter Training Specialist\- Testimony Capture is responsible for sourcing, onboarding, and training court reporters within the Testimony Capture department. This role helps design and maintain training programs, documentation, and quality standards to ensure reporters are fully prepared to deliver high\-quality services. Works cross\-functionally with Operations, Assignments, Production, and Customer Support to support reporter readiness, platform proficiency, and ongoing performance.

 **What you'll do*** Sources court reporters through approved recruiting platforms, including Rippling
* Conducts interviews, evaluates qualifications, and supports hiring decisions for reporters
* Manages onboarding process, including documentation, system access, and initial readiness checks
* Trains reporters on company processes, operational expectations, and quality standards
* Delivers training on Remote Legal platforms and related technology tools
* Creates, maintains, and updates training scenarios, guides, and reference materials
* Develops procedures and training documentation to support consistency and quality across reporting team
* Coordinates with Operations and Assignments to identify training needs and performance gaps
* Provides refresher training, updates, and process rollouts as procedures evolve
* Supports remediation and targeted retraining when quality or compliance issues are identified
* Maintains accurate training records and onboarding documentation for reporters
* Monitors training effectiveness and recommends improvements based on feedback and outcomes
* Ensures training aligns with legal, procedural, and company standards
* Develop, review, and update the quality rubric to ensure alignment with company standards
* Establish and enforce a consistent cadence for feedback
* Facilitate and lead regular quality calibration sessions
* Create and distribute detailed feedback based on quality reviews and audits
* Review markups and scorecards prepared by others for accuracy and consistency
* Maintains strict confidentiality of all company, client, and reporter information
* Recruits, onboards, trains, and oversees direct reports as assigned; provides coaching, guidance, and development
* Sets team priorities, allocates workload, and ensures coverage for onboarding, training delivery, and quality reviews
* Leads performance management activities for direct reports, including goal setting, ongoing feedback, documentation, and support for corrective action when needed
* Establishes repeatable team workflows, documentation standards, and knowledge\-sharing routines to support consistent delivery and coverage
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Qualifications*** Strong training, facilitation, and instructional design skills
* Ability to clearly communicate processes and technical concepts
* Strong organizational and documentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple onboarding and training workflows simultaneously
* High attention to detail and quality standards
* Problem\-solving mindset with ability to adapt training to reporter needs
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop team members in a remote environment
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, remote environment
* Experience with court reporting workflows or legal proceedings preferred
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with multiple departments

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience).
* 2\-5 years of professional experience, including:


o Experience in training, onboarding, operations, or related roles
o Experience in legal, court reporting, or related environments **W****ork Environment*** This is a primarily remote position performed from a home office or approved remote work location; limited travel may be required periodically for training, meetings, or other business needs.
* All work is conducted through secure, company\-approved technology platforms via computer, phone, and video conferencing platforms.
* Reliable high\-speed internet access and a private, secure workspace are required.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work for extended periods at a computer workstation in a remote, home\-based environment.
* Ability to perform repetitive motions, including frequent typing, keyboarding, and use of a mouse or other input devices.
* Ability to view computer screens, read digital documents, and analyze information for prolonged periods.
* Ability to occasionally adjust or move home office equipment weighing up to 10 pounds
* Some evening or weekend work may be required depending on client needs or emergency situations.
* Ability to travel to surrounding areas or states as needed.

new_jobs.title: Data Center Operations Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure**

  

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.\-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high\-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

  

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI\-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


You will own the technical and commercial vetting that turns a raw deal into a fundable project — the work that separates a defensible capacity commitment from an inflated one. When a partner asks Crux to guarantee an eight\- or nine\-figure sum, you're the one who tests that number against schedule, equipment composition, and real construction cost before it goes to leadership. Reporting into the Chief Program Manager's organization, you will sit at the interface between Data Center Construction, Energy, MEP, and Finance, making sure every project in the active portfolio is executed against the numbers it was approved on — and flagging it immediately when it isn't.

**In this role, you will:**

* Vet the technical and commercial terms of new capacity deals — schedule, equipment cost, equipment composition — before they're recommended to leadership, right\-sizing commitments rather than defaulting to the number a partner asks for.
* Track every live data center project in the portfolio against its approved cost and schedule baseline, and own the process for flagging and escalating variance early.
* Partner with Data Center Construction, Energy, and MEP Systems teams to translate field\-level execution status into Finance\-ready program reporting.
* Own the interface between build\-side execution and the cost and margin model of record — your data is what Finance's models are actually built on.
* Run the change\-control process for scope, schedule, or cost changes on active projects, with sign\-off gates that keep Finance and Development aligned in real time.
* Build and maintain the tools that make deal vetting fast and repeatable — this cannot be a one\-off analysis redone from scratch on every deal.
* Default to AI\-agentic workflows for cost/schedule reconciliation and variance tracking, rather than adding headcount to keep up with portfolio growth.

**SIGNALS OF SUCCESS**

**After 60 days in this role:**

* Deal\-vetting framework (schedule, equipment cost, composition) is documented and applied to at least one live negotiation.
* Portfolio cost/schedule tracking is live for the current active project set.

**After 6 months:**

* Variance escalation process is running with a documented track record of catching at\-risk projects before they slip.
* Finance's cost and margin model of record is being fed directly from your tracking, not reconstructed separately.

**After 1 year:**

* Deal\-vetting and portfolio\-tracking functions run as a repeatable system others can execute against, not a one\-person effort.

**EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH**

**Experiences**

* 8\+ years in data center construction, capital projects, or infrastructure delivery with direct P\&L, cost, or schedule ownership.
* Demonstrated experience vetting or negotiating capacity/commercial terms against real technical and cost data, not top\-down assumptions.
* Comfortable moving fluently across finance, construction, and technology — this is not a single\-lane specialist seat.

**Attributes**

* “$900M is the ask” is a hypothesis until the equipment and schedule say otherwise — you test the number before you defend it.
* You bring bad news first, unprompted, and own the result — hierarchy doesn't intimidate you and you don't intimidate easily either.

**Mindset**

* High tolerance for ambiguity. The portfolio will outgrow whatever process exists today, and you build the next version rather than waiting for one.
* AI\-agentic first. Fluent with AI agents — or committed to becoming so quickly — and you embed them as first principles in how you and your team work, defaulting to agentic workflows before adding headcount or process.

**Nice to have (preferred, not required)**

* Background in data center construction, controllership, or capital\-projects finance specialized in the build environment.
* Experience with direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling, Level 5/IST commissioning, or other GW\-scale data center technical scope.
* Neocloud or hyperscaler experience (CoreWeave, Nebius, Nscale, Lambda, Google, AWS, Meta, Microsoft) in a program or delivery management capacity.
* Formal cost engineering, quantity surveying, or construction finance credential.

**Salary Range Information**


The annual salary range for this position has been estimated based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

**About Crux**

* We offer generous base, bonus and additional incentive based compensation
* Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* Company\-paid life insurance and disability
* Full suite of other optional benefits
* 401(k) Plan with 4% company match (USA employees)

new_jobs.title: Digital Accessibility Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Please note:** We will consider both Hybrid and Remote candidates for this role.


The Digital Accessibility Program Manager serves as the operational and subject matter backbone to the Office of Digital Accessibility’s service delivery. This role owns the day\-to\-day functioning of the digital accessibility program in managing the service portfolio, conducting accessibility evaluations, ensuring the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of accessibility reviews from team members, engaging directly with campus clients on complex compliance challenges, and tracking program performance. The Digital Accessibility Program Manager reports to the Director for the Office of Digital Accessibility.


The ideal candidate brings both digital accessibility expertise and strong program management skills, serving as a critical bridge between technical staff and Stanford clients by translating findings, balancing competing priorities, and ensuring clients leave every engagement with clear, actionable guidance. They are equally comfortable guiding a campus web team through a remediation roadmap, reviewing an engineer's audit report for accuracy and completeness, and prioritizing and managing competing tasks with concurrent deadlines.


**Core Duties:**

**Program Management:**

* Manage the digital accessibility service intake pipeline by triaging incoming requests, assigning work, tracking progress, and ensuring reviews and consultations are completed on schedule.
* Coordinate with Office of Digital Accessibility staff on workload planning, deadline management, and service delivery priorities.
* Maintain quality standards for digital accessibility deliverables and consult with digital accessibility engineers on complex findings or edge cases requiring additional interpretation. Ensure findings are presented in a manner that is solution\-focused and actionable for both technical and non\-technical clients.
Oversee the interpretation, implementation and compliance with digital accessibility standards and regulations. Recommend actions and/or resolve complex issues with institutional partners that span organizational and university boundaries.  
* 

**Program Evaluation:**

* Evaluate how existing accessibility tools are offered and based on configuration, adoption, and use, if they are meeting program goals or when alternatives should be considered.
* Identify trends in accessibility issues across campus and surface insights that inform strategy and resource planning.
In coordination with the Director, track and maintain key performance indicators and program metrics, including service volume, review turnaround times, client satisfaction, remediation outcomes, and compliance trends.  
* 

**Planning and Analysis:**

* Under supervision of the Director, execute strategic plans for the Office of Digital Accessibility, leveraging subject matter expertise to meet regulatory and technical challenges for digital accessibility.
* Design and evolve the digital accessibility service delivery model, determining how core services (e.g., audit intake, remediation consultation, procurement review, training) are structured and delivered to improve client experiences.
Apply a creative mindset and bring the ability to think outside the box to create innovative service offerings.  
* 

**Client Management:**

* Advise clients on how accessibility requirements should be applied to specific vendor evaluations while balancing the intersection of technical standards, compliance obligations, and institutional constraints.
* Support clients on complex compliance requirements, including situations requiring creative or non\-standard solutions.
* Navigate difficult conversations with stakeholders who are resistant to or overwhelmed by accessibility requirements.
* Translate technical remediation findings into actionable guidance for non\-technical content owners, developers, and procurement staff.

  
**Core Duties** :


* Lead strategic planning and analysis for complex functions or programs with significant business, regulatory and/or technical challenges requiring subject matter expertise. May provide development of program or function from initial concept to implementation.
* Manage the administration and evaluation of programs or functions. Oversee the interpretation, implementation and compliance with policies and regulations. Recommend actions and/or resolve complex issues that often span organizational boundaries.
* Represent the program or function at the university level and/or to external/internal stakeholders and constituencies.
* Develop and manage outreach strategy that includes relationship development, communications, and compliance.
* Oversee or supervise staff in the development and implementation of programs or functions.
May develop and/or oversee budgets; manage finances including monitoring, analyzing, forecasting, and reporting.  
* 

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree and eight years of relevant experience, or combination of education and relevant experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to influence and motivate constituencies which could span multiple organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated excellent planning, organizational and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated ability to make sound business decisions using good business judgment and innovative and creative problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to manage financial, organizational and staff resources.
* Excellent interpersonal and communications skills with the ability to cultivate professional and business partnerships.
* Relevant subject matter expertise.

new_jobs.description:

**You’re driven, resourceful, and above all else – remarkably smart.**


In this role, you will support the development and execution of commercial readiness plans for new product launches. Working with our clients, you play an integral role working to support the launch planning and management efforts across a variety of assets, indications and geographies. The Launch Manager will assist established and emerging life science clients by being part of the team that brings a disciplined approach to help our customers commercialize their brands. You will:

* Actively support product and application launch activities including product positioning, promotional and pricing strategies, training and working with cross functional teams

* Bachelor’s degree in business, life science or other related field
* Minimum 2yrs experience with launch management or execution of launch (marketing, branding, project management)

**Desired Requirements:**

* PMI, CAPM (Certified Associate in Project Mgt) or PMP (Project Mgt. Professional)

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $122,000 to $134,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, you're a part of the big picture. You will collaborate with colleagues across clinical and commercial disciplines to guide premarket development through post\-market commercial strategy. Every project is a chance to solve a new challenge, learn from your colleagues, and advance your career. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients' lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


Syneos Health has a voluntary COVID\-19 vaccination policy. We strongly encourage all employees to be fully vaccinated. Additionally, certain local governments or Syneos Health customers may have vaccine requirements that apply to some of our employees. These employees are required to submit proof of vaccination to Syneos Health and maintain compliance with these requirements.
  

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

new_jobs.description:

5 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer\-facing role.

This is a customer\-facing role, and is responsible for maximizing customer satisfaction, safety, and quality assurance on all assigned projects. As a Project Manager, you are a part of a dynamic team that allows you to grow as Convergint grows.

  


**For information about how we use your personal information, please see our Colleague \& Applicant Privacy Notice, available on convergint.com/careers.**

  




**Who You Are**



You have a passion for providing world\-class service to customers, colleagues and communities. You are a person of integrity with a commitment to growth, accountability and delivering results. You want to join an organization with a positive culture that embraces equal opportunity and allows everyone to be the best version of themselves at work and home. You want to grow with us and deliver results as an exceptional Project Manager.

Our company was built upon a solid foundation of 10 Values and Beliefs which drive our unmatched culture, making us the \#1 global, serviced\-based systems integrator in the industry.
